author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Upright shrimp tempura: a three-point tail fan on top and a battered body of rounded lumps that curls right at the bottom into a J, as in the reference; the current drawing had a spiky crown-like tail wider than the body and a lumpy outline with a deep inner notch, so it read as a cat or a crowned blob.
omissions: The reference's joint line between tail and body is left out (with it the fan edges cannot keep their spacing); the inner edge of the curl is smooth rather than lumpy.
